newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's AvtoVAZ says plans ADR, Eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Russia's AvtoVAZ says plans ADR, Eurobond issue.

text.p: Russia's biggest car-maker AO AvtoVAZ plans to raise funds on international financial markets by issuing American Depositary Receipts and Eurobonds, its chairman said.

"We gave such an order to the economy and finance department and it must be worked on," Vladimir Kadannikov told a news conference on Saturday. "To attract financial investors ... we shall use everything -- both Eurobonds and direct credits and we shall work with our money abroad."
He did not mention the timing of ADR or Eurobond issues.

Kadannikov did not estimate the chances of a successful international financing by AvtoVAZ, which needs billions of dollars to upgrade its Lada, Niva and Samara cars and pay off debts to the government.
AvtoVAZ is Russia's biggest corporate tax debtor with the arrears amounting to 2,81 trillion roubles on May 1, 1997.
AvtoVAZ economy and finance department head Erkin Norov told Reuters that the company was in talks with companies and investment banks on ADR and Eurobond issues.
He declined to name the companies AvtoVAZ was working with.
"I think we should wait with this as there should be a tender here, but they are the biggest investment companies of the world," he said.
